---
title: "Corrected_FC_Data_Analysis for Co-culture"
format: html
Author: Tran Thi Hong Nhung
---

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(writexl)
library(readxl)
library(ggplot2)

df <- read_excel("AK_FG_Co_results_corrected.xlsx")

OUTPUT_DIR = "FC_Coculture_Exp2" 
```

```{r}
summary_df <- df %>%
  group_by(Sample_ID, Time, Co_culture) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_cells =
      mean(corrected_Cell_size_EventsPer_μL_V_dil),

    sd_cells =
      sd(corrected_Cell_size_EventsPer_μL_V_dil),

    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

```{r}
cell_size_AK_FG_violin <- ggplot(df,
       aes(x = Time,
           y = corrected_Cell_size_EventsPer_μL_V_dil,
           fill = Co_culture,
           color = Co_culture)) +

  geom_violin(
    trim = FALSE,
    alpha = 0.4,
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.8),
    scale = "width",
    color = NA
  ) +

  geom_point(
    position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.08, dodge.width = 0.8),
    size = 1.5,
    alpha = 0.9
  ) +

  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set2",
                    labels = c("BH" = "Am+Bh", "FD" = "Am+Fd", "LM" = "Am+Lm")) +
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set2", labels = c("BH" = "Am+Bh", "FD" = "Am+Fd", "LM" = "Am+Lm")
                     ) +

  theme_classic(base_size = 30, base_family = "Arial") +

  labs(
    title = "Coculture growth dynamics",
    x = "Time (h)",
    y = expression(
      paste(
        "Cell counts (events ", mu, "L"^{-1}, ")"
      )
    ),
    fill = "Co-culture",
    color = "Co-culture"
  )

print(cell_size_AK_FG_violin)

ggsave(
  file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "AK_FG_cell_size_violin_plot.jpg"),
  plot = cell_size_AK_FG_violin,
  width = 12,
  height = 8
)
```
